guide.summary: Agent connecting to customers' ServiceNow instances (approval path unconfirmed). Where the path is unconfirmed, the agent did not find it in the provider's docs.

composio.note: Composio lists ServiceNow under 'Bring your own OAuth app'. Create a custom auth config with your own client ID and secret.

need_own_app.answer: Yes. Composio has no managed OAuth app for ServiceNow, so you must register an OAuth client in a ServiceNow instance and give Composio its client ID and secret.
reasons: No Composio-managed app exists for ServiceNow
Self-hosted or instance-specific apps need their own OAuth app
Your own app gives you control of scopes and the consent branding

scenarios.label: Agent connecting to customers' ServiceNow instances
scenarios.when_this_applies: Your agent acts for end users on ServiceNow instances using an OAuth client you register.

prerequisites.title: Instance admin access
prerequisites.detail: Managing OAuth on a ServiceNow instance requires the security_admin role. Creating the endpoint for external clients requires the admin role.

prerequisites.title: Trusted TLS certificate
prerequisites.detail: The platform does not support self-signed certificates for OAuth, and the OAuth client cannot connect to endpoints that use one.

steps.title: Set application scope to Global
steps.detail: Log in to the instance as an admin and set the application scope to Global in the top right corner.

steps.title: Copy redirect URI from Composio dashboard
steps.detail: Get the callback URL from the Composio dashboard for the ServiceNow toolkit and prepare it for the redirect field.
steps.done_when: Redirect URI is ready to paste

steps.title: Create OAuth API endpoint in Application Registry
steps.detail: Go to System OAuth > Application Registry, create an OAuth API endpoint for external clients, enter the redirect URL and submit. Multiple redirect URLs are separated by a comma and a space.
steps.done_when: Record is saved and a client ID exists

steps.title: Collect client ID and secret
steps.detail: The client ID is auto-generated. Leave the secret empty to have the instance generate one, and display it with the lock icon.
steps.done_when: You hold both the client ID and secret

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create a custom auth config for the servicenow toolkit with your client ID and secret through Composio's API.

steps.title: Confirm outside-customer requirements with ServiceNow
steps.detail: Ask ServiceNow or your partner contact whether Partner Program enrollment or any review applies before outside customers connect.

traps.title: Approval path is unconfirmed
traps.detail: No evidence states whether outside customers can connect without ServiceNow review or partner acceptance. Do not plan a launch date until this is confirmed.

traps.title: Self-signed certificates fail
traps.detail: Instances or endpoints that use self-signed certificates will not work with OAuth.

traps.title: Wrong redirect URL format
traps.detail: ServiceNow's documented redirect URLs end in oauth_redirect.do, and multiple URLs are separated by a comma and a space.

blockers.symptom: Cannot see System OAuth > Application Registry
blockers.what_it_means: Your user lacks the needed admin role on the instance.
blockers.what_to_do: Ask an instance admin for the security_admin or admin role, or have them create the record.
